outline: This course introduces engineering students the advanced mathematics in practical engineering problems, including following topics: basic engineering mathematics, the system of differential equations, Markov chain, Fourier series, partial differential equation, vector calculus and related topics.
schedule:
1. Review of calculus and engineering mathematics
2. System of differential equations
3. Markov chain
4. Fourier series
5. Partial differential equation
6. Vector calculus
scorePolicy:
40% Midterm exam
40% Final exam
20% Quiz

The grading weights are subject to adjustment depending on actual course conditions.
remarks:
1. Up to 5 students from departments other than the Department of Materials and Mineral Resources Engineering are allowed to enroll.
2. Course additions will be accepted only in the first week.
